free_tier.stated: Free plan blob storage: '10mb on the free plan and 1gb on pro'. Pro is the ceiling, so there is no free path to bulk.

egress.terms: Vals serve HTTP by default with no transfer meter — the serving side is genuinely free.

tooling: `std/blob` TypeScript API (scoped blobs on S3, global blobs on Cloudflare R2); vals themselves are HTTP endpoints at `<val>.web.val.run`.
chaining: Val creation is capped at 2,500 vals on Free with a 10 MB account-wide blob pool — the pool is per account, not per val, so it does not multiply.
limits_note: 10 MB total blob storage on Free; 1 min execution timeout; 100,000 runs/day; 80,000 character per-file source limit.
reliability_note: The R2/S3 backing is real and fast; the quota is the blocker, not the tech.

evidence.proved: 'Blob-stored data counts towards your total Val Town storage – 10mb on the free plan and 1gb on pro' (page last updated September 10, 2026)
Free: 2,500 vals, 1 min execution timeout, 100,000 runs/day
